title: A Record Year of Award-Winning Excellence Across JBS Australia

body_markdown:
JBS Australia brands, products and teams received outstanding recognition across prestigious food industry awards this year including Royal Queensland Food, Wine & Beer Awards, Sydney Royal Fine Food Awards and Melbourne Royal Australian Food Awards.


These results showcase the strength of JBS Australia's diverse portfolio, spanning premium beef, lamb, Wagyu, value-added products and smallgoods, while reflecting the dedication of its people across every stage of the supply chain. From the producers and processing facilities to quality assurance, product development, operations, logistics and commercial teams, these achievements belong to all those who contribute to delivering exceptional products every day.
